page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The x86_64 architecture utilizes a single thread per core configuration, ensuring dedicated execution resources without simultaneous multithreading.

The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage attachment for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by an 80 Gbps baseline bandwidth, facilitating high-throughput data transfers.

Given the dedicated core allocation and high network throughput, this instance delivers predictable compute performance for CPU-bound tasks. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs makes it a cost-efficient choice for workloads that rely heavily on raw processing power and network bandwidth rather than local disk speed or hardware acceleration. Suitable workloads include high-performance computing, batch processing, web serving, and distributed analytics.
